lead: A bench whose round calls back into Novis cannot meet `// bench: allocations 0`, and `--record-perf` refuses the figure rather than recording it.
body: `nvs_runtime::call_closure` builds each call's argument slots in a heap vector (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/lib.rs` `# Known gaps` 10), so a fold over three ints with nothing of its own on the heap still measures 5 allocations per op. Declare `allocations 0` only where the round enters no closure — `count` does and `map`, `filter` and `reduce` do not — and read the measured number as the member's cost plus one vector per callback.
